decisive_spans.text: Emergent cerebral angiography revealed diffuse stenosis and a beaded pattern of the anterior and middle cerebral arteries and their branches, along with diffuse luminal narrowing and dysplastic changes in the right distal vertebral artery and basilar trunk, consistent with cerebral angiitis

response.rationale: The cerebral angiography findings are highly specific for Primary Central Nervous System Vasculitis, while the other diagnoses are less supported or contradicted.
